However, there is a suble difference between Venenation's counters
and Nefertit's counters. Anson can have 8 of Nefertiti's counters on
him (with him being an 8 cap; no skill or capacity raising effects on him)

actualy be stolen at that point.

> and still not be stolen. by Nefertiti's controller. Anson would need to
> have a Corruption counter by either "Corruption" or "Venenation" to
> actualy be stolen at that point.

I don't see how.

Corruption
"+1 stealth action. (D) Put a corruption counter on a vampire or ally
controlled by your prey. If the number of your corruption counters on the
minion equals or exceeds the blood capacity of that vampire or the cost of
that ally, you may burn all of your corruption counters on that minion to
gain control of him or her."

Veneation
"Only usable when this acting minion is blocked, before combat begins. [ser]
Place a corruption counter on the blocking minion. If the number of your
corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds the blood capacity of
that vampire or the cost of that ally, you may burn all of your corruption
counters on that minion to gain control of him or her (instead of starting
combat). Otherwise, combat occurs as normal. [SER] As above, but the cost of
this card is reduced by 1 blood."

Nefertiti
"Independent. Nefertiti can place a corruption counter on a minion
controlled by your prey as a +1 stealth (D) action that costs 1 blood. +1
bleed."

They come from different sources ( and potentially have different owners )
but Corruption and Veneation don't care where they come from, they only care
who owns them.

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> > However, there is a suble difference between Venenation's counters
> > and Nefertit's counters. Anson can have 8 of Nefertiti's counters on
> > him (with him being an 8 cap; no skill or capacity raising effects on him)
> > and still not be stolen. by Nefertiti's controller. Anson would need to
> > have a Corruption counter by either "Corruption" or "Venenation" to
> > actualy be stolen at that point.
> I don't see how.

The answer is apparent in each card's text.

> Corruption
> "+1 stealth action. (D) Put a corruption counter on a vampire or ally
> controlled by your prey. If the number of your corruption counters on the
> minion equals or exceeds the blood capacity of that vampire or the cost of
> that ally, you may burn all of your corruption counters on that minion to
> gain control of him or her."

There is a clause in the above card text that tells you what you can do (take
control) if the number of counters is >= capacity.

> Veneation
> "Only usable when this acting minion is blocked, before combat begins. [ser]
> Place a corruption counter on the blocking minion. If the number of your
> corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds the blood capacity of
> that vampire or the cost of that ally, you may burn all of your corruption
> counters on that minion to gain control of him or her (instead of starting
> combat). Otherwise, combat occurs as normal. [SER] As above, but the cost of
> this card is reduced by 1 blood."

There is a clause in the above card text that tells you what you can do (take
control) if the number of counters is >= capacity.

> Nefertiti
> "Independent. Nefertiti can place a corruption counter on a minion
> controlled by your prey as a +1 stealth (D) action that costs 1 blood. +1
> bleed."

The only thing this says is you can put counters on. It doesn't say what
happens if there are counters >= the minions capacity.

> They come from different sources ( and potentially have different owners )
> but Corruption and Veneation don't care where they come from, they only care
> who owns them.

Indeed. However, Nefertiti doesn't have text indicating what happens when
her corruption counters are >= capacity. You need a "Corruption" or
"Venenation" for that. This is why I said Anson can have 8 Nefertiti counters
on him and still not be stealable by Nefertiti's controller.

Sorrow

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Talonz51" <Talo...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:3bfb5003.452921067@news...

> A related question: I was under the impression that Nefertiti can add
> counters, but cannot herself take over the vampie with her corruption.
> ie:you must 'finish' the corruption of the vamp with vene or
> corruption action card.

> Is this true?

Yes.

Nefertiti has no text allowing you to use the Corruption
Counters she places to take control of a vampire.

You must play a Corruption action card or a Venenation action
modifier to take control of a vampire with Corruption Counters.

Carpe noctem.
